- Pulse's icon is black again (the blue ground was tried and taken back); the process list has thin lines between its columns as well as its rows.
- Windows 11 desktop: every taskbar button opens its own panel: Start the Start menu, Search its own search flyout (apps, settings, the web, contacts when on), the connection / sound / battery button the quick settings (toggles, brightness, volume, battery), the clock the notifications, calendar and a focus bar.
- Files, Move to Secure Folder: the file is copied first, its size is checked and only then is the original removed (it was moved at once and could be lost); a failed step leaves the file where it was.
- Files, the 3-dot menu of a file: two rows of five icons (Cut, Copy, Rename, Delete, Archive; Info, Shortcut, Bookmark, Share, Open with), a long press names the icon; the code editor, Save as, Copy path and Secure Folder stay as a short list under them.
- Keyboard backup: what is on the keyboard now (theme, size, open key rows) is written first, so the backup holds all of it.
- YTXTube: the web addresses of a video's description are marked and open when tapped (a YouTube address in YTXTube, any other in the browser).
- YTXTube: every video's menu has Open as Music, which plays the video's audio in Pulse's music player.
- YTXTube: the player goes to the mini player with a shorter pull or a gentler flick (it took a long, hard swipe); coming back from the mini player the video view is laid out again so it fills the stage (it stayed in the left column).
- Game Hub: a short quiet notification (the game's name and icon) when a game starts.
- Keyboard: saved e-mail addresses are offered two at a time (they are long), words three.
- YTXTube: a playing video is read ahead up to two minutes (it was 30 seconds) and kept in the disk cache, and it goes on loading with the screen off (a network wake lock was already held).
- Windows desktop (Windows 11 Settings): the real eleven groups (System, Bluetooth & devices, Network & internet, Personalization, Apps, Accounts, Time & language, Gaming, Accessibility, Privacy & security, Windows Update), each setting opening the matching page of the phone or of Pulse; Personalization has the accent colors (green included), the transparency switch and a preview; System has the device card.
- Windows desktop (Control Panel): the classic white window with the eight categories, View by Category / Large icons / Small icons, an address bar and a search box; every applet opens the phone's or Pulse's page.
- Windows desktop: a mini registry (For developers): the three hives of the phone's settings (System, Global, Secure) with search, edit, add and delete like SetEdit, a tweaks list on top; it writes through the app when the phone allows (WRITE_SECURE_SETTINGS from adb, Write settings) or through root / Shizuku.
- Pulse Files as another app's picker opens in the folder view, not in Recents.
- Windows 11 Start menu: the quick folders (Settings, File Explorer, Documents, Downloads) beside the power button, the phone's name at the user spot, and a phone companion panel docked on the right (phone and battery, Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, Messages, Calls, Send files, recent activity) on a wide or turned screen, or upright with a setting in the launcher settings.
- Windows desktops: the drawn mouse arrow is only for a finger; with a real mouse the system's own pointer is the only one (two arrows showed).
- Windows 11 desktop: the Control Panel window has its title bar in the accent colour.
- Spotify sign-in: without your own Client ID nothing is sent (it ended in INVALID_CLIENT); the page says how to get one (developer.spotify.com, redirect address pulse-spotify://callback).

- Keyboard: one-time codes from incoming SMS are offered in the bar (5/6 digits), same as from notifications.
- A "no SMS" APK (Pulse-2.0.15-nosms.apk) is built next to the lite one: no SMS/MMS permissions, so Play Protect has nothing to warn about.
- YTX: video / list split slider in settings (default 35/65, wide layout); search box on a channel's Playlists tab.
